title: Door Money actions: Launch mechanics
summary: Two bounded owner exercises use only the recorded synthetic brief.

tasks.title: Review the fictional launch note
tasks.why: The synthetic brief identifies one manual message worth testing.
steps: Personalize the prepared draft outside the system.

templates.label: Fictional launch email
templates.body: Hello, I am testing an invented neighborhood reading series. Would a short sample suit your fictional program?

tasks.expectedImpact: One owner-recorded signal about the synthetic premise.

tasks.title: Read the sample script aloud
tasks.why: The invented script needs a manual clarity check.
steps: Record whether its first sentence was clear.

templates.label: Synthetic short-video script

tasks.expectedImpact: A recorded owner judgment about the opening line.

completion.outcome: The owner marked the synthetic opening clear after one reading.
